page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g7 family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and utilizes the x86_64 architecture. The server features 128 dedicated physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. With a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, each of the 128 vCPUs corresponds to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs on this instance type.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers a high-density compute and memory profile suitable for enterprise workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation without the overhead of hyperthreading. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-effective option for workloads that rely entirely on network storage and CPU-bound processing. Appropriate workloads include large-scale web serving, enterprise databases, container orchestration, and general-purpose application servers.
